Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Shopping Suggested vocabulary shop, shopkeeper, market, supermarket, buy, price,
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Fluency, part of Shopping Suggested vocabulary shop, shopkeeper, market, supermarket, buy, price, in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we pause as we read texts? 2. 2. What do we do if we cannot read a word?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The learner’s interaction with digital devices is enhanced as they read digital texts.

• Learning to learn: The learner’s independent reading skills are enhanced they practise reading sentences containing decodable and non- decodable words.

38

Values:
Unity: The learner’s cooperation skills are enhanced as they work collaboratively with peers in carrying out group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self-esteem): The learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they acquire reading fluency skills.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Reading fluency is emphasized in both Kiswahili and Indigenous language activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Digital texts, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital devices

with filter keys/key guards/larger mouse/head control input devices such as head wand

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
